text.EN: We're getting ready to head out.
text.TL: Naghahanda na tayong umalis.

text.EN: Double-check your pack and gear before we leave.
text.TL: Suriing muli ang bag at gamit bago tayo umalis.

text.EN: Making preparations for the run now.
text.TL: Naghahanda na para sa pagbiyahe ngayon.

text.EN: Gather what you need. Departure is soon.
text.TL: Tipunin ang kailangan mo. Aalis na agad.

text.EN: Check weapons, food, and water.
text.TL: Suriin ang armas, pagkain, at tubig.

text.EN: Prepping for the excursion. Almost ready.
text.TL: Naghahanda para sa paglabas. Halos handa na.

text.EN: Let's make sure nothing essential gets left behind.
text.TL: Tiyaking walang mahahalagang gamit na maiiwan.

text.EN: Getting everything squared away for the road.
text.TL: Inaayos ang lahat para sa paglalakbay.

text.EN: Final checks before we open the gates.
text.TL: Huling pagsusuri bago buksan ang tarangkahan.

text.EN: Prepare your supplies. We move shortly.
text.TL: Ihanda ang mga supply. Kikilos na tayo maya-maya.

text.EN: We're getting ready. Make sure you've got what you need.
text.TL: Naghahanda na tayo. Siguraduhin mong dala mo ang kailangan mo.

text.EN: Take your time prepping, friend. Better safe than sorry.
text.TL: Maghanda nang mabuti, kaibigan. Mas mabuting handa.

text.EN: Need help packing anything up, partner?
text.TL: Kailangan mo ba ng tulong sa pag-iimpake, kasama?

text.EN: Got an extra bandage if you need one. Let's prep well.
text.TL: May sobra akong bendahe kung kailangan mo. Maghanda tayo nang maayos.

text.EN: Excited and nervous, but we've got each other. Ready up!
text.TL: Kaba at sabik, pero magkasama tayo. Maghanda na!

text.EN: Make sure you've eaten and drank water before we go.
text.TL: Tiyaking nakakain at nakainom ka bago tayo umalis.

text.EN: Getting ready! We'll make this a successful run together.
text.TL: Naghahanda na! Gagawin nating matagumpay ang biyaheng ito.

text.EN: Double-check your boots and bandages, friend.
text.TL: Suriin ang bota at bendahe mo, kaibigan.

text.EN: I'm right here prepping alongside you. We'll do great.
text.TL: Nandito lang ako naghahanda kasabay mo. Magiging maayos tayo.

text.EN: Readying supplies. Stay positive, we've got this!
text.TL: Inihahanda ang mga gamit. Maging positibo, kaya natin ito!

text.EN: Get ready. We leave soon.
text.TL: Maghanda. Aalis tayo agad.

text.EN: Pack up.
text.TL: Mag-impake.

text.EN: Check gear.
text.TL: Tingnan ang gamit.

text.EN: Prepping.
text.TL: Naghahanda.

text.EN: Load out.
text.TL: Ihanda ang karga.

text.EN: Almost time.
text.TL: Malapit na.

text.EN: Ready weapons.
text.TL: Ihanda ang armas.

text.EN: Moving soon.
text.TL: Aalis na agad.

text.EN: Supplies ready.
text.TL: Handa na ang supply.

text.EN: Final checks.
text.TL: Huling pagsusuri.

text.EN: Prep first. We move when everyone's ready.
text.TL: Maghanda muna. Aalis tayo kapag handa na ang lahat.

text.EN: If you forget something vital out there, nobody is turning back for you.
text.TL: Kapag may naiwan kang mahalaga, walang babalik para sa 'yo.

text.EN: Check your ammunition count twice. No excuses.
text.TL: Bilangin ang bala mo nang dalawang beses. Walang palusot.

text.EN: Sharpen your blade now. We don't stop for maintenance in the field.
text.TL: Hasiin ang talim mo ngayon. Walang hinto para magkumpuni sa labas.

text.EN: Pack light, pack lethal. Don't carry useless junk.
text.TL: Magdala ng magaan at nakamamatay. Huwag magdala ng kalat.

text.EN: Inspect your boots. A twisted ankle out there is fatal.
text.TL: Suriin ang sapatos mo. Nakamamatay ang maipit ang paa sa labas.

text.EN: Be completely ready before you step past that gate.
text.TL: Maging handang-handa bago lumabas sa tarangkahang 'yan.

text.EN: Check your medical supplies. You bleed, you fix it.
text.TL: Tingnan ang gamot mo. Kapag nagdugo ka, gamutin mo sarili mo.

text.EN: Preparing now. Stay disciplined once we cross the threshold.
text.TL: Naghahanda na. Maging disiplinado paglabas natin.

text.EN: Lock and load. Don't slow the group down.
text.TL: Magkarga ng armas. Huwag mong pabagalin ang grupo.
